problem_text:
The ages of people dining in two restaurants are shown in the following box plots.
[Image: The box plots show the ages in Restaurant A and B]
Select all the statements that must be true.

Answer choices:
A. The median age of people dining in Restaurant B is greater than the median age of people dining in Restaurant A. || The MAD (mean absolute deviation) for Restaurant B is greater than the MAD (mean absolute deviation) for Restaurant A. || The youngest person was dining in Restaurant A. || The IQR (interquartile range) for Restaurant A is equal to the IQR (interquartile range) for Restaurant B. || Every person dining in Restaurant B is older than everyone dining in Restaurant A.
